readings.moment: The temple struck ten while Girard sat alone in the dining room after dinner.
Girard went out into the street to smoke ("twenty-one minutes past ten by my watch").
The piano started up in the salon as Girard lit his cigar.
Girard heard faint, quick bells from the master's window ("twenty-six minutes to eleven by my watch").
Girard came back into the house ("fourteen minutes to eleven by my watch").
The hall clock had just struck eleven as Girard came back in.
The hall clock's face showed two minutes past eleven as Girard came back in.

whereabouts: Girard was at dinner with the household, at Aurèle's table.
Monnier made the men take out their watches at dinner.
Girard quarrelled with Monnier at the table about the repeater and raised his voice.
After dinner Girard sat on alone in the dining room with the brandy.
Girard went out into the street to smoke.
Girard stayed under the front windows of the house.
The piano started up in the salon.
Faint, quick bells came from the master's window up above.
Girard came back into the house.
Girard went straight up to Félix in the library.
Félix was in the library with Girard.
Girard and Félix talked about Félix's debts in the library.
